tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All Terms and Condition as per tender document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Performance Statement for 4 years 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25 (Annexure-6) should be uploaded
Tender Offer Form duly filled and signed by the supplier as per the format enclosed in Annexure-1
Compliance of technical specifications complete with clarifications for deviations
Relevant detailed brochures/literatures of their company pertaining to equipment complete with make, model, country of origin, year of manufacture, end of manufacture, end of service of equipment.
Tender Declaration Form duly filled and signed as per the format enclosed in Annexue-2
Attested copy of the latest Manufacturing License

If representative or dealer or distributor is submitting tender, he must produce copy of such authorization Certificate from the manufacturer (Annexure 5) and no more than one person can make tender on behalf of same manufacturing firm or company for same material.
Complete details of the Manufacturing unit (Annexure-7) should be uploaded
Tenderer should compulsorily upload audited balance sheet for 3 years i.e. 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25 duly certified by competent auditors
Warranty period or guarantee period particulars should be uploaded
Tenderer should upload the copy of the PAN Card
Service Centers in Karnataka & Trained Technical Staff available
Annual Turnover Statement for the last 3 years i.e 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25should be compulsorily certified by competent auditors and uploaded
